==Description==
'''A-85''' is a bright cyan meanacing face, which contains a wide smile with a set of small, bright cyan teeth, and eyes with blue outer parts of the eyes. It can easily be identified by its electrical ambience.

==Behavior==
'''A-85''' spawns at the newly generated room's center and stays here while making whispering noises. After 4 seconds of staying, '''A-85''' proceed to move backwards. Any player seen by A-85 will get rapidly damaged, killing them quickly. A-85 will despawn once it goes for enough.

==Strategy & Tips==
*When you hear it's spawn sound, immediately hop into a locker. Although '''A-85''' doesn't pose a threat, don't risk it.
*In [[Red Rooms]], '''A-85'''<nowiki/>'s health is reduced to 2 shots (with Perfectionist). So use it on advantage if it spawns together with other entity in [[Red Rooms]] like [[A-135]].

==Trivia==
*'''A-85''' is easy to survive if you are expecting it.
*'''A-85''', like A-20, does not care for tables, and will treat them as if the player isn't hiding at all.
*'''A-85''' can be shot, causing him to despawn immediatly after enough shots (5 shots with Perfectionist).
*If a player opens the next doors before '''A-85''' falls back, '''A-85''' will rush fowards until reaching the unopened door and then will fall back.
**To do this, simply open the next door and quickly hide
